risks.t: uncertainties involving the following: the Company’s ability to manage expenses at sustainable levels
acceptance of the Company’s products in the marketplace
the effect of global economic conditions, including tariffs, on the ability and willingness of customers to purchase its technology
timing of regulatory approvals, including as it relates to Robocath’s products and our ability to make further draws on the convertible note financing
the impact of pandemics or other disasters
the other risks discussed in the Company’s periodic and other filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission
